status: Focused checks and full Node candidate 6 RPM functional checks pass; all four separately documented optimizer diagnostics were approved on 2026-10-05.

fixes.change_value_overflow: The original text and blob APIs evaluate 1 + varint_length + value_length as int before assigning to sqlite3_int64. At INT_MAX both overflow by six bytes. UBSan reproduces both failures using a valid 2 GiB virtual buffer. Promote the sum before addition, retain strlen in size_t until checked, and use the existing SQLITE_NOMEM allocation-failure behavior.
fixes.fallthrough: Mark all 16 intentional dimension-unrolling transitions using SQLite's existing deliberate_fall_through macro.
fixes.varint_size: Make the existing implicit conversion to size_t explicit in the comparison to sizeof(aCopy); behavior is unchanged.
fixes.crypto_expectations: Use size_t expectations for nine size_t memory constants; preserve every expected value and assertion.

tests.baseline: results/node-sqlite-length-1/cases.json: text=1, blob=1; both signed integer overflow diagnostics match the root cause.
tests.fixed: 104 truncated/bounded varints, 36 value cases including explicit and negative UTF-8 lengths, empty/large blobs, ten oversized text/blob failures; ten RTree dimensions/types; GeoPoly valid/NULL/malformed rows; deferred FK changeset; 250 allocation-failure points. -Werror, UBSan, and Valgrind pass; 71,739 allocations freed.
tests.crypto: Two existing NodeCrypto cases pass, no sign-compare warnings, Valgrind zero errors and zero definite/indirect/possible losses. Four ncrypto header API deprecations are already approved.
tests.translation_units: Patched exact release SQLite command at -O2 is clean. The unchanged three optimizer warnings remain in the upstream test-build -O3 command and require separate approval.

approval_update_20261005: The four recorded GCC 15 optimizer sites were approved on 2026-10-05; see node-remaining-compiler-diagnostics-20261003.json. Canonical/native qualification remains separate.
